sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 505 (all 235 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are not permitted at DEC campgrounds. Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/hearthstone-point/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=505 ('Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'DEC Campgrounds: Same-day reservations will be allowed until 5pm on day of arrival at all DEC campgrounds ... Walk-ins will not be permitted'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 nights. From July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights will be permitted at any campground'; CHECK-IN TIME 'From 2:00 p.m. until 9:00 p.m.') + https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf (Hearthstone Point RES MIN 2), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DEC lists 243 sites; ReserveAmerica sells 235 plus a group camp. The longest listed length is 30 ft (59 sites); 99 are listed at 20 ft and the rest carry no length.

note: DEC on Lake George, 2 mi N of the village; the campground is largely across Rte 9N from the lake; sand beach and swimming area. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $22 + $5 non-resident, 2-night pre-season minimum, 243 sites and phone 518-668-5193 (DEC 2026 summary), 2027 season May 14 - Sep 11 (matches the manual season), no electric, dump. Changed max_rig_ft 40 -> 30 (derived from note prose; ReserveAmerica's longest listed site is 30 ft). Added 9-month window, 14-night max (DEC row, now on the entry), no walk-ins, showers, flush toilets, water spigots. Note trimmed of field facts and the minimum-stay line.
flags: max_rig_ft lowered 40 -> 30: the 40 ft came from the sweep note ('RVs to 40 ft', probably DEC's page, which answers 403 to scripted reads); ReserveAmerica lists no site longer than 30 ft (59 sites at 30 ft). If DEC's own page says 40 ft, a reviewer may prefer it.
